The '''Republic Service Organization center''' was a building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that served as a lounge for off-duty members of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was manned by the [[Republic Service Organization]].
